newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan PC market seen rising 24 pct in 1997/98.
newsitem.headline: Japan PC market seen rising 24 pct in 1997/98.

text.p: Japan's personal computer market will continue to enjoy fast growth in the next business year, with PC shipments expanding 24 percent from year-ago levels, a trade association said on Friday.
The Japan Electronic Industry Development Association said that would follow an estimated 31 percent gain for the current business year.
The association expects Japan's PC shipments in the year starting April 1997 to total 9.3 million units, up from an estimated 7.5 million units for the current business year.
Greater demand for PC-based network systems will continue to buoy PC sales both at small and large businesses, the association said.
In value terms, Japan's PC market will grow 14 percent to 1.84 trillion yen in 1997/98, the association said.
